rv.q: But the universe does not unfold for us with ease and the discoveries may not be as revelatory as we hope either.
I suspect it's because the underlying script is an inert and shapeless thing, and tang has only partially committed to its story.

Subsequent scenes appear to take place earlier, eventually going back to Matt and Harriet in their childhood home, plotting to run away. Isabel, or somebody who looks just like them, turns out to be the forest ranger sent to search for the missing teens.

cn.t: Critics are divided on reid tang's experimental play, praising its unpredictable imagery and non-linear structure while questioning its overall effectiveness as theater.
